title: build.ps1: pass SolutionDir when building a single project

proposed_comments.body:
**[P2] Preserve inferred `SolutionDir` for spaced checkout paths**

When the inferred solution directory contains a space, this branch warns and omits `/p:SolutionDir`, and the single-project call to `RunMSBuild` receives no inferred value. On the pinned `PowerRenameContextMenu.vcxproj`, evaluating without that property resolves `SolutionDir` and `IntDir` under the project directory; passing the inferred spaced solution root instead moves `IntDir` under that root. `OutDir` remains under `$(RepoRoot)`, so this is not an `OutDir` relocation. Because the project’s pre-build command runs `MakeAppx.exe pack /d .`, keeping intermediates in the project tree can undermine the isolation intended for package input; actual MSIX contamination was not reproduced. Please pass the inferred solution directory to `RunMSBuild` as a separate parameter and argv element before caller-supplied `ExtraArgs`, so an explicit `/p:SolutionDir` still wins, and reset the value for each project. Do not remove this guard alone: `RunMSBuild` splits `ExtraArgs` on spaces.

confidence.rationale: Pinned source, argument captures and actual-project property evaluation establish the omitted-property fallback and intermediate-directory placement. Actual package contamination and spelling validation are unverified.
